mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_execution_daily_stat ( stat_date, user_id, workflow_id, workflow_name, execute_count, success_count, failed_count, total_duration_ms, avg_duration_ms, max_duration_ms, min_duration_ms, total_actual_node_count, avg_actual_node_count, last_start_time ) SELECT #{statDate}, user_id, workflow_id, COALESCE(MAX(workflow_name), ''), COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COALESCE(SUM(duration_ms), 0), COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)), 0), COALESCE(MAX(duration_ms), 0), COALESCE(MIN(duration_ms), 0), COALESCE(SUM(actual_node_count), 0), COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(actual_node_count), 2), 0), COALESCE(MAX(start_time), 0) FROM workflow_execution WHERE start_time >= #{dayStart} AND start_time < #{dayEnd} GROUP BY user_id, workflow_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE workflow_name = VALUES(workflow_name), execute_count = VALUES(execute_count), success_count = VALUES(success_count), failed_count = VALUES(failed_count), total_duration_ms = VALUES(total_duration_ms), avg_duration_ms = VALUES(avg_duration_ms), max_duration_ms = VALUES(max_duration_ms), min_duration_ms = VALUES(min_duration_ms), total_actual_node_count = VALUES(total_actual_node_count), avg_actual_node_count = VALUES(avg_actual_node_count), last_start_time = VALUES(last_start_time)
mapper.select: SELECT bot_qq AS botQQ, name AS name, is_online AS online, online_since AS onlineSince FROM bot WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plugin_info WHERE author_id = #{userId}) AS pluginCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plugin_info WHERE author_id = #{userId} AND is_public = 1) AS publicPluginCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS workflowCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND enabled = 1) AS enabledWorkflowCount

SELECT workflow_id AS workflowId, MAX(workflow_name) AS workflowName, SUM(execute_count) AS executeCount, SUM(total_duration_ms) AS totalDurationMs, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(execute_count), 0)), 0) AS avgDurationMs, SUM(total_actual_node_count) AS totalNodeCount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total_actual_node_count) / NULLIF(SUM(execute_count), 0), 2), 0) AS avgNodeCount, MAX(last_start_time) AS lastExecutionTime FROM workflow_execution_daily_stat WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY workflow_id

SELECT workflow_id AS workflowId, MAX(workflow_name) AS workflowName, COUNT(*) AS executeCount, COALESCE(SUM(duration_ms), 0) AS totalDurationMs, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)), 0) AS avgDurationMs, COALESCE(SUM(actual_node_count), 0) AS totalNodeCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(actual_node_count), 2), 0) AS avgNodeCount, COALESCE(MAX(start_time), 0) AS lastExecutionTime FROM workflow_execution WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND start_time >= #{dayStart} AND start_time < #{dayEnd} GROUP BY workflow_id
